description:
ABOUT COTY


Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. At Coty, we celebrate and nurture a culture of kindness. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We believe that beauty lies in diversity and are committed to continuing to build an environment where all talents can thrive. We deeply value the unique contributions each individual brings to our team. As part of our commitment to inclusion, all profiles are welcome.


MISSION


Lead and transform site manufacturing activities by strategically managing resources and people to maximize performance across cost, quality, productivity, service levels, safety, and environmental sustainability. As a key executive leader, you will define and implement the strategic direction for the manufacturing unit, ensuring continuous improvement and operational excellence aligned with global company needs.


RESPONSIBILITIES


Strategic Development & Vision

  • Determine the short, medium, and long-term strategic direction for the manufacturing site, focusing on people, processes, and management methods to drive efficiency and profitability.
  • Connect the site’s vision to the organizational culture through a Compelling Business Need (CBN).
  • Direct and restructure the manufacturing unit's strategic alignment to optimize resources and processes.


Operational Excellence & Management Systems

  • Guarantee the systematic implementation of a Manufacturing Management System based on Lean 6 Sigma and TPM methodologies.
  • Establish a high-performance culture centered on safety, quality, results, process control, and standardization.
  • Implement and oversee a robust maintenance management system to ensure equipment reliability, availability, and cost evolution.
  • Manage the site performance through KPIs deployed at the operational level, ensuring regular monitoring (daily, monthly, annually) and corrective actions for any deviations.


Financial Stewardship & Innovation

  • Elaborate and manage the area budget using Zero-Based Budgeting (OBZ) principles to optimize production processes and reduce costs.
  • Lead CAPEX and replacement management for the manufacturing unit, ensuring investments align with Industry 4.0 concepts and basic condition restoration.
  • Support innovation processes and cost-reduction projects by ensuring feasibility and resource availability within planned timelines.


Team Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead a multidisciplinary team, fostering engagement, accountability, and high performance.
  • Form a high-performance team through a structured Skills Matrix aligned with the company’s long-term objectives.
  • Build a solid succession plan and provide continuous feedback to develop leadership and technical competencies.


REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS


  • Higher education degree with a mandatory Post-Graduate or MBA specialization.
  • Experience: Minimum of 9+ years of proven experience in large-scale industrial environments.
  • Advanced English is required for frequent interaction with global teams.
  • Deep knowledge in TPM, Lean 6 Sigma, Maintenance Management, and Industrial Cost Management.
  • Advanced proficiency in SAP (or similar ERP) and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Must be able to work 100% On-site in Senador Canedo / GO, Brazil .

Remuneração:  R$350–R$450 por semana (de acordo com o nível) + bônus (com base em visualizações)

Período de teste:  2 semanas, pago R$250 / semana


Sobre o Pure

O Pure é um aplicativo de namoro global e ousado que está redefinindo a forma como as pessoas se conectam. Acreditamos que o namoro deve ser honesto, divertido e livre de julgamentos — um espaço para explorar confiança, química e autoexpressão.

Estamos construindo uma comunidade de criadores UGC para ajudar a contar essa história.


Sobre a Comunidade de Criadores UGC

Estamos procurando criadores de conteúdo para redes sociais para se juntarem à nossa Comunidade de Criadores UGC do Pure — um grupo que produz vídeos curtos (TikTok / Instagram) sobre temas como namoro, confiança, amor-próprio, entre outros.

Como criador, você terá a oportunidade de colaborar com o nosso time, desenvolver sua marca pessoal e ser pago para criar conteúdos autênticos e envolventes que desafiam a forma como as pessoas enxergam o namoro.


O que você vai fazer
  • Criar e postar 7 vídeos curtos por semana (TikTok / Instagram Reels / YouTube Shorts, etc.)
  • Desenvolver conteúdos inspirados em namoro, conexões e autoexpressão
  • Direcionar pessoas para o app
  • Participar de briefings criativos, tendências e campanhas
  • Receber feedback e orientação para melhorar sua performance
  • Colaborar com o time em ideias de storytelling e estratégias sociais


O que buscamos
  • Você deve estar baseado no Brasil e ser fluente em português
  • Paixão por storytelling, redes sociais e cultura contemporânea
  • Familiaridade com tendências do TikTok, formatos de Reels e conteúdo UGC
  • Boa presença em frente às câmeras e habilidades de edição
  • Consistência e capacidade de cumprir metas semanais de conteúdo
  • Mente aberta e conforto para criar conteúdos sobre namoro e relacionamentos


Estrutura de pagamento
  • Estrutura por níveis com pagamento semanal
  • Bônus por visualizações (a partir de 100 mil views)
  • Bônus por registros
  • Pagamentos realizados semanalmente
Por que se juntar a nós
  • Seja pago para criar conteúdo autêntico sobre namoro e autoexpressão
  • Acesso a orientação criativa, briefings e uma rede global de criadores
  • Construa seu portfólio enquanto colabora com a gente
  • Liberdade criativa — seu estilo, sua história, sua perspectiva

    • Como se candidatar

    Envie sua carta de apresentação e conte um pouco sobre você, incluindo por que gostaria de trabalhar com o app Pure.

    Você será convidado para uma call de onboarding em grupo e receberá uma tarefa para criar um vídeo de teste.

    Depois disso, você entrará em um período de teste de 2 semanas e, se for aprovado, será totalmente integrado ao programa.

    As candidaturas são analisadas de forma contínua.

title: Coordenador de Engenharia (Eficiência e Tecnologia)
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

title: Sales Representative
description:
• Routres


Routres is an AI-powered digital commodities marketplace transforming the way global steel trade operates. By combining intelligent automation, real-time data, and intuitive user experience, we simplify procurement, optimize pricing, and accelerate deal-making for buyers and suppliers worldwide. Our platform enables faster transactions, transparent negotiations, and smart decision-making all within one unified digital ecosystem designed to bring efficiency, clarity, and innovation to the steel industry.


1. Role Summary


The Sales Representative plays a key role in transforming global steel trade by driving adoption and growth of our AI-powered digital commodities marketplace. This position manages complete end-to-end sales process prospecting, onboarding, negotiation, deal execution, and post-sale follow-up while fostering strong, trust-based relationships with clients and suppliers worldwide.

In addition to promoting the platform, the Sales Representative delivers personalized support and consultation services , helping clients navigate the marketplace, optimize pricing strategies, and enhance their steel trading operations.


Key Responsibilities


1. End-to-End Marketplace Sales Management

  • Manage the complete sales cycle on the AI-powered commodities marketplace, including lead generation, client onboarding, negotiation, order execution, and delivery coordination.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and suppliers, ensuring a seamless, transparent, and efficient digital transaction experience.
  • Use marketplace tools, AI-driven insights, and analytics to monitor offers, understand pricing trends, and optimize deal structures for clients.

2. Business Development & Growth

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities to expand the platform’s user base and grow sales across long and flat steel products.
  • Explore cross-border opportunities by connecting Latin American clients with premium suppliers in Europe, Asia, and other global markets.
  • Apply data-driven insights and market intelligence to uncover new segments, emerging demand, and strategic growth opportunities.

3. Client Relationship Management & Personalized Support

  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients and suppliers, prioritizing trust, responsiveness, and exceptional service.
  • Provide personalized consultation and advisory support to help clients navigate the platform, understand market conditions, and optimize their steel procurement and trading strategy.
  • Deliver an elevated customer experience through tailored solutions, real-time pricing insights, digital tools, and proactive, value-added support.

4. Collaboration & Coordination

  • Partner with Operations, Logistics, Finance, and Compliance to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant execution of all orders.
  • Work closely with Product and Technology teams by providing client feedback and market insights to improve marketplace features, AI capabilities, and user experience.

5. Market Intelligence, Analytics & Reporting

  • Stay up to date on global steel market dynamics, competitor activity, and commodity price trends to support strategic decision-making.
  • Prepare sales forecasts, pipeline updates, performance reports, and insights for commercial leadership.
  • Utilize marketplace analytics to track KPIs, conversion rates, deal performance, and customer behavior.

6. Innovation, Impact & Client Enablement

  • Promote the adoption of digital and AI-powered solutions that enhance efficiency, pricing transparency, and smart decision-making in steel trade.
  • Suggest innovative approaches to improve platform engagement, increase transaction volume, and strengthen client outcomes.
  • Represent the company at industry events, virtual forums, and online communities to strengthen brand presence and communicate the value of the platform and consulting services.



4. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Sales, Business, International Trade, Marketing, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2–3 years of B2B sales experience, ideally in steel and commodities or digital marketplaces.
  • Proven ability to manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and negotiation to closing and post-sale support.
  • Experience working with international suppliers or clients, preferably in Latin America, Europe, or Asia.
  • Strong analytical skills and proficiency in CRM tools, Excel/Google Sheets, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with a client-centric consultative approach.
  • Ability to understand and explain AI-powered tools, digital platforms, or technology-driven solutions to clients.
  • Fluency in portuguese, English (Spanish is a plus) and willingness to travel when required.

title: Account Manager
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, people-first Account Manager who can build lasting client relationships, keep projects moving, and make sure every client feels informed, supported, and confident every step of the way.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an \"unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You'll Do


  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing relationships, setting expectations, and delivering excellent service at every touchpoint.
  • Translate client marketing goals into clear, actionable tasks, and coordinate with the Marketing Coordinator for execution.
  • Lead regular client meetings, share updates and deliverables, and ensure everything stays aligned with client expectations.
  • Use Jiminny to document meetings, capture key takeaways, and package notes, action items, and recordings using our meeting template.
  • Review final deliverables before submission to ensure quality, relevance, and client readiness.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and industry contacts to strengthen collaboration and drive long-term success.
  • Handle client concerns and dynamics with professionalism, composure, and emotional intelligence.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of experience in account management, client services, or a similar client-facing role.
  • Clear, confident communication skills, you can manage expectations, present deliverables, and handle tough conversations without breaking a sweat.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance multiple clients, meetings, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • A strategic mindset, you connect client goals to the bigger picture and collaborate with senior team members to get there.
  • High emotional intelligence, you read the room, stay composed under pressure, and build trust naturally.
  • Proficiency using AI tools such as Claude and Gemini to improve workflows, streamline communication, and enhance overall efficiency.
  • Copywriting experience, you can craft clear, on-brand messaging and support content needs when required.
  • Experience in a digital agency or marketing environment is a strong plus.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.


Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with project management or CRM tools.
  • Experience presenting creative or marketing work to clients.
  • Background in digital marketing, understanding what your team is building makes you a better advocate for your clients.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Reports to the Director of Accounts
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you're someone who genuinely loves building relationships, thrives on keeping things organized and on track, and takes pride in making clients feel like they're in the best hands, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Gerente Administrativo
description:
Gerente Administrativo – Clínica de Grande Porte (Recife/PE)


Você não está sendo contratado para “organizar o administrativo”.


Você está sendo contratado para assumir uma parte relevante da operação da clínica — com impacto direto em resultado financeiro, relacionamento com convênios, segurança jurídica e estabilidade da equipe.

Somos uma clínica com aproximadamente 150 colaboradores, em crescimento, com operação complexa e alto volume de atendimentos. Precisamos de alguém que não execute tarefas, mas que pense, organize e conduza.


Responsabilidades do cargo


Você será responsável por estruturar, acompanhar e evoluir quatro pilares centrais da clínica:


1. Financeiro e Lucratividade

Apresentar mensalmente os indicadores financeiros da clínica

Identificar desperdícios, distorções e gargalos operacionais

Propor e acompanhar ações concretas de melhoria de resultado

Apoiar a direção na tomada de decisão com base em números


2. Faturamento e Convênios (ANS / Planos de Saúde)

Acompanhar indicadores de faturamento

Atuar diretamente na redução de glosas

Estruturar e melhorar o relacionamento com operadoras

Organizar processos de envio, conferência e recurso de contas


3. Jurídico e Compliance

Acompanhar processos judiciais da clínica

Fazer interface com o escritório jurídico

Garantir cumprimento de prazos e obrigações legais

Atuar preventivamente em situações de risco


4. Gestão de Pessoas

Estruturar plano estratégico de gestão de pessoas

Atuar na redução de rotatividade

Desenvolver lideranças internas

Melhorar o ambiente de trabalho de forma prática


O perfil que buscamos:

  • Experiência sólida em gestão administrativa na área da saúde
  • Vivência com faturamento de convênios e relacionamento com operadoras
  • Capacidade de leitura de indicadores e tomada de decisão
  • Organização e acompanhamento de processos jurídicos
  • Experiência real em gestão de equipes
  • Postura de dono, sem depender de comando constante
  • O que não funciona nesse cargo
  • Perfil operacional que espera ordens
  • Falta de domínio em convênios e faturamento
  • Dificuldade com números e indicadores
  • Gestão de pessoas baseada apenas em conversa, sem método


Modelo de remuneração

Fixo: R$ 10.000,00

Até R$ 2.000,00 de premiação variável por performance (4 metas):


1. Meta Financeira

Apresentação consistente de indicadores + propostas implementadas de melhoria de lucratividade

2. Meta de Faturamento

Redução de glosas + melhoria de processos + fortalecimento do relacionamento com operadoras

3. Meta Jurídica

Acompanhamento ativo dos processos + acionamento adequado do jurídico + cumprimento das obrigações legais

4. Meta de Gestão de Pessoas

Redução de rotatividade + evolução do clima organizacional + desenvolvimento das lideranças


A remuneração variável está diretamente ligada à entrega real, não à intenção.


Consideração final﻿

Essa não é uma vaga para quem quer estabilidade.

É uma vaga para quem quer assumir responsabilidade, organizar uma operação grande e crescer junto com a clínica.

Se você já fez isso antes, vai se destacar rápido.

Se ainda não fez, provavelmente não é o momento.

COMO FUNCIONA O MODELO DE ATUAÇÃO

1. Estrutura comercial e administrativa centralizada

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer

Location: Costa Rica, Brazil or Mexico

Focus: Digital & Customer Experience Applications


Role Summary

We are seeking a Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets. This role is pivotal in enabling Digital and Customer Experience applications across our global enterprise. You will work hands-on with Python, PySpark, and Databricks, championing modern engineering practices through Git-based workflows, CI/CD, and Azure DevOps to ensure high-quality data delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Development: Design and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks and PySpark to transform and serve data for digital customer journeys.
  • Data Modeling: Build performant SQL transformations and curated dimensional data layers for downstream analytics and application consumption.
  • Engineering Excellence: Implement best practices for Databricks (notebooks vs. repos), modular code, cluster configuration, and cost-aware performance tuning.
  • Automation & Scripting: Utilize Python for data validation, orchestration helpers, and the creation of reusable libraries.
  • DevOps & CI/CD: * Manage source control via Git (GitHub/Bitbucket), enforcing strict PR reviews and branching strategies.
  • Build and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines to automate testing, packaging, and deployment across environments.
  • Quality & Reliability: Ensure data integrity through automated reconciliation checks, monitoring, and detailed operational runbooks.
  • Collaboration: Partner with product teams, analysts, and platform engineers to translate complex requirements into scalable data products.
  • Leadership (Senior Level): Lead module-level design, mentor junior engineers, and take ownership of critical pipeline delivery and enterprise code standards.


Technical Skills

Primary (Must-Have)

  • Advanced Data Engineering: Expert-level Python , PySpark , and SQL (advanced querying and optimization).
  • Databricks Ecosystem: Proficiency in Databricks jobs, workflows, clusters, and repos.
  • Version Control: Strong experience with Git (GitHub and/or Bitbucket) and enterprise branching workflows.
  • Azure DevOps: Hands-on experience with Boards, Repos, and Pipelines for build/release automation in data workloads.

Secondary (Good-to-Have)

  • Orchestration: Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for ingestion and scheduling patterns.
  • Data Visualization: Understanding of Power BI datasets, measures, and refresh patterns to support analytics enablement.

title: Controlling Supervisor
description:
Role Description

This is a full-time, on-site role for a Controlling Supervisor located in Sorocaba, SP. The Controlling Supervisor will oversee financial planning, cost management, and budgeting processes to ensure operational efficiency. They will analyze financial performance, create detailed financial reports, and provide insights to support decision-making. The role includes collaboration with cross-functional teams, ensuring compliance with company policies, and identifying areas for cost optimization and process improvement.

Conduct financial planning (annual and monthly budget vs. actual), in accordance with the parent company's calendar and guidelines, consolidating information from various areas and preparing financial analyses and statements to support senior management in decision-making;

Perform CAPEX analyses (budgeted vs. actual), monitoring deviations and opportunities for optimization;

Ensure the planning and control of working capital, through the projection of revenues, costs, expenses, payroll, accounts receivable and payable, inventories and taxes, identifying financial needs and opportunities;

Prepare monthly results budget and Balance Sheet, with critical analysis and consolidation of systemic data and data from other areas, supporting preventive and improvement actions;

Monitor the results of cyclical inventories, both internal and external, ensuring adequate financial impact;

Monitor and audit company materials held by suppliers, performing physical vs. system reconciliations and ensuring the accuracy of balances;

Perform monthly P&L closing, analyzing revenues, costs, operating expenses, freight, payroll, and extraordinary variations, in accordance with internal rules and procedures;

Update financial and operational databases (volumes, prices, average costs, risks, and opportunities), contributing to the predictability of monthly and annual results;

Prepare and report financial and management indicators to the plant and headquarters, through systems, reports, and executive presentations;

Prepare and update management presentations and strategic reports;

Attend to internal and external audits, providing information, analysis, and evidence;

Provide technical support to area employees, guiding and clarifying doubts related to controllership processes;

Perform other related activities inherent to the position, as directed by the immediate supervisor.

Assess the impacts of exchange rate variations, mapping exchange rate exposure based on imported items and performing scenario simulations; • Prepare monthly results budget and Balance Sheet, with critical analysis and consolidation of systemic data and data from other areas, supporting preventive and improvement actions;


Qualifications

  • English - Fluent
  • SAP Experience
  • Strong financial management skills, including budgeting, forecasting, and cost control
  • Proficiency in financial analysis tools, reporting systems, and accounting software
  • Excellent leadership, team coordination, and decision-making abilities
  • Analytical skills with attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities
  • Understanding of compliance standards, internal controls, and corporate regulations
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills in both Portuguese and English
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Relevant experience in controlling, financial management, or a similar leadership role
  • Experience in manufacturing or automotive industries is a strong advantage

title: Coordenador de Planejamento e Controle
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.


Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .


Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.


Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.


Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.


Missão do cargo:


Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Planejamento e Controle para atuar de forma estratégica no processo de FP&A, com forte integração às áreas operacionais e papel essencial no suporte à tomada de decisão da alta administração, por meio de análises econômico-financeiras robustas e modelos financeiros complexos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Coordenar e acompanhar os processos de planejamento estratégico, orçamento anual, revisões periódicas (forecast) e controle orçamentário;
  • Desenvolver, estruturar e manter modelos financeiros complexos, incluindo:
  • Projeções financeiras de longo prazo;
  • Modelos de viabilidade econômico-financeira;
  • Simulações de cenários (sensibilidade, stress, upside e downside);
  • Modelos contratuais com múltiplos indexadores e diferentes estruturas de reajuste;
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas operacionais, contratos, engenharia e comercial, traduzindo dados técnicos e operacionais em impactos financeiros claros e acionáveis;
  • Apoiar negociações contratuais, revisões de preços, pleitos e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
  • Estruturar, acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais;


Requisitos técnicos

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em Planejamento e Controle Financeiro (FP&A);
  • Domínio avançado de modelagem financeira, especialmente em Excel (ou ferramentas equivalentes), incluindo:
  • Experiência com contratos de longo prazo, concessões ou setores intensivos em capital (infraestrutura, saneamento, resíduos, energia ou similares);


Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência em empresas de infraestrutura, saneamento, meio ambiente ou serviços públicos;
  • Vivência com indexadores econômicos, reajustes contratuais e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.

Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.


Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.

title: ANALISTA MERCHANDISING/BUYER
description:
A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.


⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO


Responsável por realizar compra das coleções e acompanhamento dos indicadores da área de produto, como OTB, compras, vendas, cash flow, margem, Sell Thru e Loss end. Garantir a correta precificação e alocação de produtos na loja, bem como treinamento para equipe de loja. Ter contato direto com a loja e demais áreas que possuem interação para garantir o alinhamento 360° em relação a produto e a otimização da venda/giro. Responsável pela movimentaçao entre estoques, garantindo a acuracidade da oferta em cada canal. Responsável pela interface com o Iguatemi365, no que tange aos kpis da área: oferta, precificação, disponibilidade de produtos, giro, venda por produto.


RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?


Realizar a concepção do OTB (open to buy) diante da projeção e vendas determinada, considerando marca, coleções, categorias, subcategorias, itens, grade. Para acuracidade, deve considerar analise de histórico e tendências.

Realizar o processo de compra de produtos. Receber material da nova coleção, entender a inspiração junto a marca, analisar vendas e definir qual será o investimento de cada categoria (+subcategoria, itens, grade). Avaliar tendências e integrar equipe de varejo na definição dos produtos.

Realizar a precificação de produtos em linha com as premissas definidas e alinhadas com a marca e internamente determinadas pela iRetail. Sugerir as premissas adequadas para cada marca e momento, para tanto é necessário entender o mercado, analisar concorrência, para garantir que atingiremos os resultados definidos em budget.

Estar frequentemente em loja para acompanhar as vendas dos produtos junto à equipe de loja (in loco na loja), olhar tanto quantitativo quanto qualitativo, avaliar a exposição dos mesmos, reforçar o treinamento da equipe sobre a marca e os produtos. Propor sugestões de ações internas para melhoria do giro dos produtos (kpi); conectar frequentemente com Varejo e Marketing para discutir oportunidade e viabilidade de ações. Proatividade na busca de soluções para melhor girar produto.

Acompanhar o mercado de varejo, como ações e preços de concorrentes. Fazer uma análise crítica com relação ao que estamos praticando e, se necessário, propor mudanças.

Responsável pelo conhecimento das informações relacionadas a produto, assim como o treinamento da equipe. Garantir o conhecimento de todos os envolvidos no prazo necessário para que consigam agir em suas respectivas áreas.

Garantir junto a área de Operações o recebimento dos produtos nos prazos necessários. Acompanhar todos os embarques e entender impactos de possíveis atrasos nos recebimentos e lidar com o Controle de Qualidade (processos, interface loja, com a marca e solicitar os devidos reembolsos).

description:

In this role, you will lead and develop a team of recruiters while owning end-to-end talent delivery strategy and execution across multiple roles.


You will partner closely with Sourcing, Client Success, and leadership to deliver high-quality talent, improve recruiting performance, and scale talent operations. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines execution, strategy, and team development.

Lead & Develop the Recruiting Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters
  • Set clear performance expectations and talent quality standards
  • Provide structured feedback, training, and mentorship
  • Foster a high-performance, accountable, and collaborative team culture

Own Full-Cycle Recruiting Execution

  • Anticipate challenges and adjust strategies proactively

Elevate Candidate Evaluation & Talent Quality

  • Define and refine candidate assessment frameworks
  • Implement and oversee technical testing and evaluation processes
  • Ensure consistent and objective candidate selection across roles
  • Maintain high standards for candidate quality and role fit


Drive Operational Excellence

  • Improve recruiting workflows, processes, and documentation

  • Manage referral programs and internal recruiting initiatives


Leverage Data & Continuous Improvement

Required Experience



  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

  • Experience managing multiple roles and stakeholders simultaneously
  • Ability to translate business needs into effective talent strategies

  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

Desired Experience



  • Experience recruiting for technical roles

  • Exposure to recruiting analytics, reporting, or process optimization
  • Experience in growth-stage or startup environments


Additional Information



  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior
description:
Responsabilidades

Conhecimentos sólidos em sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux/Unix.

Conhecimento em aplicação de patches de segurança, validação pós-implantação e troubleshooting básico em caso de falhas.

Conhecimento em processos ITIL.

Capacidade analítica e olhar crítico para validação de procedimentos e ações em ambientes complexos.

Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento, como Zabbix, Grafana ou similares.

Conhecimento em scripts e automação, como Shell Script, Bash e Python.

Experiência com ferramentas de automação e infraestrutura como código (Ansible, Terraform e IaC).

Experiência com ambientes de Middleware, como WebLogic, JBoss, Tomcat, entre outros.

Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de vulnerabilidades, como Qualys, Tenable ou similares.

Experiência prévia em processos estruturados de gestão de vulnerabilidades.

Noções de classificação e priorização de vulnerabilidades com base em CVSS.

Conhecimento em hardening de sistemas operacionais e servidores.

Experiência com geração de relatórios executivos e técnicos sobre vulnerabilidades, exposição e remediação.

Vivência em ambientes críticos, com processos formais de mudança e janelas controladas para aplicação de correções.

Graduação em áreas de tecnologia da informação ou experiência equivalente.

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a delivery fulfillment platform designed specifically to support local businesses. We help these businesses manage their deliveries efficiently by connecting them with skilled drivers tailored to meet their delivery needs. Additionally, we provide essential tools for logistical, financial, and marketing support, empowering local food and beverage makers to expand their businesses


Role of the QA Team:

Our QA team is crucial in ensuring the quality of our platform. There are two main tasks you will focus on:

  • Bug Analysis: Understand and diagnose bugs that make it into production. This requires a solid understanding of our product and excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Proactively finding issues that affect users: Identify parts of the system that need to be improved according to feedback coming from users and testing. You need to be able to clearly report the problem and propose a solution.
  • Feature Verification: Manually check whether new features work as intended. This involves strong analytical skills to assess user experience and interface design.


While specific technical skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code, and creating automated tests are very beneficial, they are not required.


We're looking for candidates with strong English, product usage analysis skills, and excellent communication. This is a full-time, Monday-to-Friday position, with working hours from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (Boston time), including a one-hour lunch break.

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Buscamos um Gerente de Projetos Sênior altamente qualificado para gestão de projetos de tecnologia, com foco em desenvolvimento de sistemas e produtos, implantação de infraestrutura, integração com sistemas legados, implementações de APIs e soluções em ambientes de nuvem. title: Billing analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2 B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.
Key Responsibilities
Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up. Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2 C) processes.
Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
Professional proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications
Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments. Our compensation package:
- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).

description:

Visão geral da posição
Como Engenheiro(a) de Software Principal na equipe de Administração de Membros dentro das soluções de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção da Autodesk, você será responsável por orientar a equipe de engenharia e liderar o design técnico para construir funcionalidades que preparem nossos clientes para o sucesso no Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).

Pesquisar e impulsionar a adoção de novas tecnologias
Identificar riscos e propor estratégias de mitigação relacionadas à arquitetura da aplicação
Participar ativamente de revisões de código e pull requests
Colaborar com diversas equipes dentro da ACS, tanto locais quanto internacionais
Atender, em regime de rodízio, incidentes críticos fora do horário comercial ou nos fins de semana para garantir disponibilidade 24/7 da plataforma Qualificações mínimas
Mais de 8 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software e tecnologias web
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em produção com aplicações em infraestrutura de nuvem em larga escala
Experiência avançada na construção de APIs RESTful, microsserviços e interfaces front-end
Experiência avançada com frameworks Java Script (Node.js, React)
Experiência avançada com SQL/Postgres
Forte conhecimento em AWS e arquiteturas em nuvem
Experiência sólida com ferramentas de manutenção e monitoramento de aplicações
Experiência sólida na criação de automações e pipelines de CI/CD
Experiência liderando uma equipe de pelo menos 3 engenheiros de software
Familiaridade com Docker para criação de aplicações containerizadas
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de se comunicar com diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes de produto, clientes e engenheiros de software

Habilidade de colaboração remota em equipes distribuídas
Flexibilidade diante de mudanças e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees. We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.
If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us!
Job challenges:
- Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT;
- Monitor, and enforce KNOT's HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation;
- Monitor companyactivities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements;
- Ensure adherence to Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) and applicable local legal requirements, supporting their correct application in the workplace;
- Manage the availability, distribution, and correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
- Take part in investigations and analyses of work-related accidents, incidents, and near misses;

- Develop and support educational actions and safety campaigns related to occupational health and safety.
- Participate in HSEQ audits and inspections, both onshore and onboard vessels/facilities.
- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits;
- Participate in emergency response drills and simulations;
- Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures;
Requirements:
- Technical degree in Occupational Safety;

- Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs);

Benefits we offer:

title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership TM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
- Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
- Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
- Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
- Advanced English (spoken and written),
- Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
- Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
- High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
- Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
- Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
- Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
- Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
- Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
- Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
- Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
- Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
- Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,
- Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,
- Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,
- Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil,
- Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
- Hybrid working model,
- One day off on your birthday,
- Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
- Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
- Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
- Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),
- Well-being and quality of life programs, including Total Pass,
- Professional and personal training and development opportunities,

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.
Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.
This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.
We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.
If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us!
Job challenges:
- Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT;
- Monitor, and enforce KNOT's HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation;
- Monitor company activities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements;
- Ensure adherence to Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) and applicable local legal requirements, supporting their correct application in the workplace;
- Manage the availability, distribution, and correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
- Take part in investigations and analyses of work-related accidents, incidents, and near misses;

- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits;
- Participate in emergency response drills and simulations;
- Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures;
Requirements:
- Technical degree in Occupational Safety;
- Previous experience as an Occupational Safety Technician, preferably in the maritime/naval industry;
- Advanced English (frequent interaction with Norwegian colleagues and other cultures) – will be tested;
- Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs);
- Intermediate Excel skills;
- Desirable: Bachelor's degree;
- Desirable: Experience with e Social system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting).
Benefits we offer:
- Food allowance;
- Transportation allowance without discount;
- Health and dental plan at no cost;
- Life insurance;
- Private pension;
- Profit-Sharing;
- Well Hub Membership.
If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.
All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Meitu campus ambassador (analytics track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship
We're looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.
What you'll do:
● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what's hot, what's not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.
● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.
● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.
● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.
We're looking for someone who is:
● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the "why" behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.
● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.
● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.
Bonus if you have:
● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.
● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).
● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.
What You'll Get
Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team
● Early access to product features and training sessions
● Workshops on social media, product, or design
Rewards & Credit System
We'll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!
Redeem credits for:
● Annual Meitu products membership
● " Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador" Certificate + internship reference
● Meitu Special Deisgn
● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership
● Summer Internship Offer
● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)
About Meitu
Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.
Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357. HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.
At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Finance analyst - collection, finance
description:
About Voxy
Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.
Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.
We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you're on board, we would be happy to discuss.
You can find additional information about our values at this link (
The Impact You'll Have at Voxy
Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.
What You'll Be Doing:
Collections & Cash Application:
• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.
• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.
• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.
• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP& A Manager.
• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.
• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.
• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.
Credit Analysis & Risk Management:
• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.
• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.
• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.
Reporting & Analysis:
• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.
• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.
• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.
• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP& A Manager or Senior FP& A Analyst.
What We're Looking For:
• B. A/B. S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
• Based anywhere in Brazil
• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish
• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.
Job Details:
• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year
• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)
In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you'll enjoy:
• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)
• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events
• Remote friendly work policies
• Professional development budget
• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify
• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world
• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)
We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.
Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.
In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.
As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: Salesforce administrator
description:
Position Overview:
As a Salesforce Administrator, you will play a foundational role in building and scaling our CRM ecosystem. This position goes far beyond traditional administration—you will help architect a next‐generation CRM platform that supports rapid scaling, automation‐first operations, and AI‐driven decision‐making across the organization.
You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and our Contact Center leadership team to design intelligent workflows, optimize business processes, and create a flexible, automated CRM foundation.
Responsibilities:
Administers day‐to‐day Salesforce operations, including user access, permissions, security controls, page layouts, objects, record types, and data governance.
Builds scalable automation (primarily using Flows) to replace manual processes and improve operational efficiency across teams.
Partners with cross‐functional stakeholders to map business processes, identify gaps, and design technical solutions aligned with business requirements.
Translates business requirements into detailed user stories, functional specifications, and structured workflows.
Analyzes CRM usage patterns, funnel metrics, and customer service trends to recommend operational and process improvements.
Builds dashboards and reports that surface insights for leaders, including case trends, SLA performance, agent productivity, lifecycle metrics, and GTM funnel health.
Maintains documentation of data models, configurations, integrations, automations, and process maps.
Collaborates with stakeholders to build lead management flows, sales processes, customer lifecycle models, and AI‐powered workflow automations.
Designs, optimizes, and maintains Salesforce Service Cloud functionality supporting the Contact Center, including case management, omni‐channel routing, macros, and agent console configurations.
Partners with Contact Center leadership to analyze operational bottlenecks and design scalable workflows that reduce agent handle time and improve customer experience.
Supports and enhances CTI/telephony integrations and related automations, including screen pops, routing logic, call dispositions, and agent productivity tooling.
Ensures secure, least‐privilege access by owning the configuration and governance of profiles, permission sets, and role hierarchies aligned with Contact Center needs.
Identifies proactively opportunities to improve processes, workflows, routing, and system performance, particularly within the Contact Center environment.
Manages data imports and updates, including deduplication, cleansing initiatives, and data governance enforcement.
Supports integration efforts with core internal systems, marketing automation platforms, billing solutions, and internal tools.
Delivers training, onboarding, and ongoing support to drive strong user adoption across fast‐scaling teams.
Troubleshoots issues proactively and serves as the go‐to expert for Salesforce reliability, scalability, and performance. Position Requirements:
4 years of Salesforce Administration experience, ideally in an enterprise‐level or high‐velocity environment.
Salesforce certifications, such as Administrator or Advanced Administrator, are preferred.
Ability to work from our Austin-based headquarters, at least four days per week – excluding approved time off and business travel. Additional Requirements:
Strong expertise in Salesforce configuration, automation (Flows), data modeling, and security architecture.
Experience supporting Contact Center or Service Cloud environments, including agent workflows, case management, routing, or telephony integrations (preferred).
Proven ability in requirements gathering, process design, workflow mapping, and reporting/analytics.
Background supporting Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, or cross‐functional GTM operations.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn CRM data into insights and actionable recommendations.
Familiarity with integrations, connected apps, APIs, middleware, and data sync patterns (no coding required, but technical comfort is essential).
Hands‐on experience with lead routing, funnel analytics, lifecycle automation, or revenue operations tooling is highly valued.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a fast‐moving, high‐growth environment.

title: Senior ruby on rails engineer
description:
About Stay FiStay Fi combines Io T and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable Wi Fi guest network with a custom-branded Wi Fi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.
Over the past 8 years, we've built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we're growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We're a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we're creating tools that our customers truly love. About You
You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
You're curious about Io T, Wi Fi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight. About the Role
Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, Postgre SQL, Tailwind CSS, React and Java Script, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.
Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team. Why Work at Stay Fi?
You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.
You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Chief revenue officer
description:
Chief Revenue Officer
The Opportunity
We're looking for a seasoned Chief Revenue Officer to help our client — an AI-powered logistics Saa S company — build and scale their US enterprise revenue engine from the ground up.
Our client is a Houston-based, seed-funded logistics platform founded in 2019. They bring consumer-app simplicity to enterprise logistics, unifying appointment scheduling, dock and yard management, and gate digitization for shippers, 3 PLs, and carriers.
They've built real product-market traction and are now ready to scale. That's where you come in.
The Role
Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll own the entire US enterprise revenue motion end-to-end — strategy, hiring, pipeline, forecasting, and expansion. This is a rare \"own the whole thing\" seat: you'll set GTM strategy, build the team, and personally drive early pipeline until that team is in place.
What You'll Do
Build and execute the US enterprise GTM strategy from scratch
Hire, onboard, and lead the full revenue organization — AEs, BDRs, and sales management
Personally carry and close strategic early enterprise deals while the team ramps
Own pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue operations
Partner with the CEO on pricing, packaging, and market positioning
Establish the sales culture, process, and playbook for a company scaling from near-zero to multi-million in ARR What We're Looking For
Required:
15–20 years of revenue leadership experience at the CRO level
Demonstrated track record scaling revenue from near-zero to multi-million within US enterprise
Proven experience hiring, building, and leading revenue teams (AEs, BDRs, sales managers) — not a solo operator with a CRO title
Deep logistics or supply chain industry experience
Native-level English and executive-level presence
Willingness to provide 2–3 references from prior employers You'll thrive in this role if you:
Have reference-able revenue numbers you can point to from prior companies
Are energized by building from scratch rather than managing a mature org
Can toggle fluidly between strategy, recruiting, and rolling up your sleeves to close deals
Have operated inside or sold into US enterprise logistics, freight, or supply chain This is not the right fit if you:
Come from a mid-market or non-logistics Saa S background
Have primarily tactical experience (AE, sales manager) without true org leadership
Lead with CRM/pipeline theater rather than produced revenue
Have never built or managed a revenue team

Client relationships. You are the face of Scalix AI for your accounts. You lead weekly/bi-weekly calls, quarterly business reviews, and the hard conversations that come with managing paid media budgets.
Campaign strategy and execution. You build, optimize, and scale Google Ads (Search, PMax, Demand Gen, Display, You Tube) and Linked In Ads (Sponsored Content, Message Ads, Lead Gen Forms, ABM campaigns) across multiple verticals.
Storytelling through data. You turn performance data into a narrative the client's CEO, CMO, or founder actually wants to read. Numbers alone don't retain clients — meaning does.
Attribution and measurement. You set up clean measurement (GA4, Linked In Insight Tag, conversion APIs, offline conversion imports) and defend the integrity of attribution when the data gets messy.
Proactive optimization. You don't wait for the client to ask. You spot, flag, and fix.
Retention and expansion. You identify opportunities to expand scope and you catch churn signals before they become churn. What We're Looking ForRequired:
5–8 years of hands-on paid media experience, with meaningful time spent in both Google Ads and Linked In Ads (not just one with a side of the other)

B2 B and Saa S paid media experience Bonus:
HVAC, home services, or nonprofit vertical experience

Linked In Marketing Labs certification and/or Google Ads certifications
Experience building SOPs, onboarding docs, or client-facing collateral Who Thrives Here
